en: YouTube / Bilibili video downloader powered by yt-dlp
zh: 基于 yt-dlp 的 YouTube / 哔哩哔哩视频下载器

en: Only download content you have the right to save, and follow each platform's terms of service and copyright rules.
zh: 请仅下载你有权保存的内容，并遵守相关平台的服务条款与版权规定。
重新运行首次设置向导

en: Signed in · 1080P and above available (4K / HDR need a premium membership)
zh: 已登录 · 可下载 1080P 及以上画质（4K / HDR 等需大会员）
未登录 · 未登录时最高只能下载 480P / 720P

en: Signed in · age-restricted and members-only videos available
zh: 已登录 · 可下载年龄限制、会员专属视频

en: Not signed in · sign in for age-restricted / members-only videos and fewer bot checks
zh: 未登录 · 登录后可下载年龄限制、会员专属视频，并减少人机验证

en: These links are added with the options below; titles appear once each download starts.
zh: 这些链接将使用下方选项直接加入队列，标题会在开始下载后自动显示。

en: Some links are not YouTube / Bilibili. yt-dlp will still try them, but they may fail.
zh: 部分链接不是 YouTube / 哔哩哔哩，yt-dlp 仍会尝试下载，但可能失败。
添加 {0} 个链接到队列

en: Paste a link on the New download page to get started
zh: 在「新建下载」中粘贴链接即可开始

en: Extracting audio needs ffmpeg. Install it in Settings → Components.
zh: 提取音频需要 ffmpeg，请先在「设置 → 组件」中安装。

en: YouTube wants to confirm you're not a bot. Sign in under Settings → Accounts, or switch proxy node.
zh: YouTube 要求验证身份。请在「设置 → 账号」中登录，或更换代理节点。

en: Couldn't read browser cookies. Close that browser and retry, or use in-app sign-in instead.
zh: 读取浏览器 Cookie 失败。请关闭该浏览器后重试，或改用应用内登录。

en: This playlist has no downloadable videos.
zh: 这个播放列表中没有可下载的视频。

en: Network error. Reaching YouTube may require a proxy (Settings → Network).
zh: 网络连接失败。访问 YouTube 可能需要在「设置 → 网络」中配置代理。

en: ffmpeg is required for this. Install it in Settings → Components.
zh: 此操作需要 ffmpeg，请在「设置 → 组件」中安装。

en: yt-dlp is not installed. Install it in Settings → Components.
zh: 未找到 yt-dlp，请先在「设置 → 组件」中安装。

en: The site returned no downloadable formats. On YouTube this usually means the sign-in cookies are no longer valid — try signing out of YouTube in Settings → Accounts, or update yt-dlp.
zh: 网站没有返回可下载的格式。在 YouTube 上通常是登录状态（Cookie）已失效所致，可在「设置 → 账号」中退出 YouTube 登录后重试，或更新 yt-dlp。

en: This is a private or members-only video; sign in with an account that can watch it.
zh: 这是私享 / 会员视频，需要登录有权限观看的账号。

en: Too many requests. Wait a while or switch proxy node, then retry.
zh: 请求过于频繁，请稍后或更换代理节点后重试。

en: The video is unavailable (deleted, region-locked or private).
zh: 视频不可用（已删除、地区限制或未公开）。
已将 {0} 个任务加入下载队列。

en: Without signing in, Bilibili offers 480P / 720P at most. Sign in to get 1080P and above.
zh: 未登录时 B 站最高只提供 480P / 720P，登录后即可下载 1080P 及以上画质。

en: The selected browser's cookies couldn't be read (Chrome / Edge lock them while running), so they were skipped this time. In-app sign-in (Settings → Accounts) is more reliable.
zh: 无法读取所选浏览器的 Cookie（Chrome / Edge 运行时会锁定 Cookie），本次已跳过。建议改用「设置 → 账号」中的应用内登录。
浏览器 Cookie 读取失败

en: No link found on the clipboard.
zh: 剪贴板中没有找到链接。

en: Please enter a valid video link.
zh: 请输入有效的视频链接。

en: Without ffmpeg only pre-merged, lower-quality files can be downloaded and audio can't be extracted. Install it in Settings → Components.
zh: 未安装 ffmpeg：只能下载已合并的低画质文件，且无法提取音频。可在「设置 → 组件」中一键安装。

en: Paste YouTube or Bilibili links — single videos, playlists, multi-part videos, or several links at once. You can also drag a link onto the window.
zh: 粘贴 YouTube 或哔哩哔哩链接：单个视频、播放列表、多 P 视频，或一次粘贴多个链接；也可以把链接直接拖进窗口。

en: VidFlow uses the open-source yt-dlp to download videos, and ffmpeg to merge high-quality streams. Install them once to get started.
zh: VidFlow 使用开源的 yt-dlp 下载视频，ffmpeg 用于合并高清音视频。首次使用需要安装。

en: Paste a YouTube or Bilibili link (separate several links with spaces)
zh: 粘贴 YouTube / 哔哩哔哩链接，多个链接用空格分隔

en: Downloaded from the official yt-dlp builds when you choose to install it; not bundled with VidFlow. Source code: ffmpeg.org.
zh: 仅在你选择安装时从 yt-dlp 官方构建下载，不随 VidFlow 分发。源代码见 ffmpeg.org。

en: VidFlow is built on these open-source components. Click a license to read it.
zh: VidFlow 基于以下开源组件构建，点击许可名称可查看完整条款。

en: Downloaded on demand and kept up to date automatically.
zh: 按需下载，并自动保持最新。

en: Sign in below (QR code supported). Your sign-in is stored only on this computer.
zh: 请在下方页面中登录（支持扫码）。登录信息仅保存在本机。

en: Signed in! Click Done to save and close.
zh: 登录成功！点击「完成」保存并关闭窗口。

en: Downloads continue in the background. Use the tray icon to reopen or exit.
zh: 下载会在后台继续。可通过任务栏通知区域的图标重新打开或退出。
检测到视频链接，是否下载？

en: The full video, or just its audio
zh: 选择下载完整视频，或仅提取音频

en: Resolutions actually available; sizes are estimates
zh: 列表中为实际可用的分辨率，大小为估算值

en: Save subtitles (if any) as separate files; languages are set in Settings
zh: 同时保存字幕文件（如果有），字幕语言可在设置中调整

en: Checks once a day. Sites change often, and an outdated yt-dlp is the most common cause of failed downloads
zh: 每天检查一次。网站经常变动，过旧的 yt-dlp 是下载失败最常见的原因

en: Chrome / Edge may be unreadable while running; close the browser or use Firefox
zh: Chrome / Edge 运行时可能无法读取，读取失败时请先关闭浏览器，或改用 Firefox

en: When you copy a YouTube / Bilibili link while VidFlow is in the background, offer to download it
zh: 在后台时复制 YouTube / 哔哩哔哩链接，会弹出通知询问是否下载

en: How many downloads run at the same time
zh: 同时进行的下载任务数量

en: Or use a cookies.txt file (takes priority)
zh: 或使用 cookies.txt 文件（优先）

en: Netscape format, exportable with a browser extension
zh: Netscape 格式，可用浏览器扩展导出

en: Also save bullet comments as an XML file when subtitles are on
zh: 开启字幕时，同时把弹幕保存为 XML 文件

en: Not installed · merges high-quality streams and extracts audio (recommended)
zh: 未安装 · 用于合并高清音视频、提取音频（推荐）

en: Prefer H.264 / AAC for older devices and built-in players; top quality may be limited
zh: 优先选择 H.264 / AAC，兼容旧设备和系统自带播放器，但最高画质可能受限

en: {0}  Downloads come from GitHub; if it can't be reached, set a proxy under Settings → Network.
zh: {0}  下载源位于 GitHub，如无法访问请先在「设置 → 网络」中设置代理。

en: Write title, author and cover into the file (needs ffmpeg)
zh: 将标题、作者和封面写入文件（需要 ffmpeg）

en: Notify when downloads finish or fail while VidFlow is in the background
zh: 在后台时，下载完成或失败会发送系统通知

en: Advanced: use cookies from a browser or a cookies.txt file instead of in-app sign-in
zh: 高级：改用外部浏览器或 cookies.txt 文件中的登录状态（会覆盖应用内登录）

en: e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890 or socks5://127.0.0.1:1080; empty uses the system proxy
The new language applies after VidFlow restarts. Unfinished downloads resume automatically.
zh: 新的语言将在重启 VidFlow 后生效，未完成的下载会自动继续。
使用系统中已安装的版本

en: In MB/s, per download; leave empty for unlimited. Applies to downloads that start after changing it
zh: 单位 MB/s，对每个任务分别限速，留空表示不限速；修改后对新开始的任务生效

en: yt-dlp language codes, comma separated (e.g. zh-Hans,en)
zh: yt-dlp 语言代码，用逗号分隔（例如 zh-Hans,en）

en: Languages to save, and Bilibili danmaku
zh: 要保存的字幕语言，以及 B 站弹幕

en: Keep running in the notification area
Closing the window keeps downloads going; exit from the tray icon
zh: 关闭窗口后下载继续进行，可从任务栏通知区域图标退出

en: Not installed · parses and downloads videos (required)
zh: 未安装 · 用于解析和下载视频（必需）
视频流已完成，正在下载音频流…

en: Optional. Signing in unlocks Bilibili 1080P+ and YouTube age-restricted videos. You can do this later in Settings → Accounts.
zh: 可选。登录后可下载 B 站 1080P 以上画质和 YouTube 年龄限制视频，也可以稍后在「设置 → 账号」中登录。

en: Sign-in happens on the official site inside VidFlow; your password is never seen or stored by VidFlow.
zh: 登录在官方网页中完成，VidFlow 不会读取或保存你的密码。

en: Downloaded videos are saved here. Playlists get their own subfolder.
zh: 下载的视频会保存到这里，播放列表会自动放进单独的子文件夹。

en: VidFlow uses two free tools: yt-dlp to download, and ffmpeg to merge high-quality video and audio. They're downloaded from their official GitHub releases (about 140 MB).
zh: VidFlow 需要两个免费工具：yt-dlp 负责下载，ffmpeg 负责合并高清音视频。它们将从官方 GitHub 发布页下载（约 140 MB）。
要添加这么多下载任务吗？

en: You're about to queue {0} videos. They download a few at a time (see Settings → Simultaneous downloads), and you can pause or cancel them in Downloads.
zh: 将添加 {0} 个视频到下载队列。它们会按「设置 → 同时下载」的数量依次下载，可随时在下载列表中暂停或取消。

en: H.264 plays everywhere; H.265 / AV1 are smaller but may not play on older devices. Falls back to the best quality if the codec isn't offered
zh: H.264 兼容性最好；H.265 / AV1 体积更小，但老设备可能无法播放。所选编码不可用时自动改用最高画质
